body:
Part of #115.

## Why

"Which profiles can report spend" is currently discoverable only by running one and finding out that it
cannot. `hkb stats` says so honestly at the point of failure, but nothing tells you before you choose a
profile, and the README calls `claude-bg` the free path without mentioning that free also means
unmeasured.

Once this track's siblings land, the answer changes — and a doc that still describes the old gap is
worse than one that never mentioned it.

## What

Document, per profile, what it reports: real cost, an estimate, raw usage, or nothing.

- Put it where someone chooses a profile, not only where they hit the wall.
- Cover the track case explicitly: what a node attempt carries versus a cold one.
- If `hkb stats`' existing message is now wrong or incomplete, say so here and fix the wording — but
  the code that produces it belongs to a sibling, so coordinate rather than editing `src/stats.js`.

Match the surrounding prose. `docs/harnesses.md` is the per-harness page; the README's profiles section
is the shorter, decision-time surface.

## Done when

- [ ] `docs/harnesses.md` states, per profile, what spend data it produces.
- [ ] The README's profiles section says the same in one line, at the point of choice.
- [ ] No page still claims spend is unavailable if the siblings changed that.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green.

## Contract

- **Read what the siblings actually shipped** — `hkb show` the tasks this one is blocked by, and run
  `hkb stats` yourself. This body was written before they ran; do not paraphrase it.
- Docs only. Do not touch `src/stats.js` or `src/hook.js`.
goal: docs state per profile what spend data it produces, including track nodes
title: Say which profiles can report spend, and what you get instead
